zh.title: Diehl Aviation 在羅馬尼亞克拉約瓦啟用新廠
zh.summary: Diehl Aviation 於 2026 年 7 月 30 日在克拉約瓦揭幕新廠，投資中雙位數百萬歐元，預計秋季投產，初期 75 人、擴至 500 人，生產複合艙組件、隔熱毯與水廢油箱。廠區全電力運作，屋頂裝設太陽能板，並計畫與當地大學合作培育人才。
body: Diehl Aviation 在 2026 年 7 月 30 日於羅馬尼亞克拉約瓦啟用新廠，佔地 33,500 平方公尺，廠房面積超過 12,000 平方公尺。
投資規模為中雙位數百萬歐元，預計 2026 年秋季開始生產，初期約 75 名員工，中長期擴增至 500 人。
新廠將生產手工疊層複合艙組件、隔熱毯與水廢系統油箱，並全電力運作，屋頂正裝設太陽能板以提高再生能源比例。
該廠區屬於 Diehl Aviation 的歐洲製造網絡，另有德國、匈牙利與墨西哥基地，並計畫與當地大學合作培育航空航太人才。

en.title: Diehl Aviation opens new aircraft component plant in Craiova, Romania
en.summary: Diehl Aviation inaugurated a new production facility in Craiova, Romania on 30 July 2026. The site covers more than 12,000 square metres of production and office space on a 33,500‑square‑metre plot. The company described the investment as a mid‑double‑digit million euro amount. Production is scheduled to start in autumn 2026 with about 75 employees, growing to up to 500 over the medium term. The plant will initially manufacture manually laminated composite cabin components, insulation blankets, and water‑and‑waste system tanks, running entirely on electricity with a rooftop solar array to increase renewable energy use.
body: Diehl Aviation opened the new facility on 30 July 2026, adding a 12,000‑square‑metre production and office area on a 33,500‑square‑metre site in Craiova.
The investment is described as a mid‑double‑digit million euro amount, with production slated to begin in autumn 2026, starting with roughly 75 staff and expanding to as many as 500.

Initial output will include manually laminated composite cabin parts, insulation blankets, and tanks for aircraft water and waste systems. The building operates solely on electricity, and a rooftop solar installation is being added to raise the renewable share.
The Craiova plant joins Diehl Aviation’s existing sites in Germany, Hungary and Mexico, and the company plans to cooperate with local universities to develop aerospace engineering talent.

zh.title: 航空業協會呼籲非洲國家規範旅客資料系統
zh.summary: 非洲航空公司協會、南非航空協會與國際航空運輸協會呼籲非洲各國政府，依照國際民航組織標準實施預先旅客資訊與旅客訂位紀錄系統。三大業界組織強調相關資料收集應遵守法律與比例原則，並重申政府不應透過向航空公司或旅客徵收費用來資助國家邊境安全計畫。
body: 非洲航空公司協會（AFRAA）、南非航空協會（AASA）與國際航空運輸協會（IATA）呼籲非洲各國政府，應依據國際民航組織（ICAO）標準實施預先旅客資訊（API）及旅客訂位紀錄（PNR）系統。
三大組織指出，旅客資料系統應遵循合法性與比例原則，且國家邊境安全計畫不應透過向航空公司或旅客徵收費用來資助。AFRAA秘書長Abdérahmane Berthé、AASA執行長Aaron Munetsi與IATA副總裁Kamil Alawadhi發表聯合聲明，強調統一標準能提升安全性並避免不必要的成本。

en.title: Aviation Groups Urge African States to Align Passenger Data Systems with ICAO Standards
en.summary: The African Airlines Association (AFRAA), the Airlines Association of Southern Africa (AASA), and the International Air Transport Association (IATA) have jointly urged African governments to align their Advance Passenger Information (API) and Passenger Name Record (PNR) programs with International Civil Aviation Organization (ICAO) standards and global best practices. The industry bodies emphasized that passenger data programs must operate under clear legal frameworks and proportionality, while cautioning against funding border security systems through fees imposed on airlines or passengers.
body: The African Airlines Association (AFRAA), the Airlines Association of Southern Africa (AASA), and the International Air Transport Association (IATA) have urged African States to implement Advance Passenger Information (API) and Passenger Name Record (PNR) systems in accordance with International Civil Aviation Organization (ICAO) standards.

The aviation organizations emphasized that passenger data collection must adhere to clear legal frameworks, proportionality, and explicit security purposes. They also urged governments not to fund national border security programs by imposing charges on airlines or passengers, noting that border security is a government responsibility under ICAO policies. AFRAA Secretary General Abdérahmane Berthé, AASA CEO Aaron Munetsi, and IATA Regional Vice President Kamil Alawadhi issued a joint statement advocating for harmonized global standards.

zh.title: 聯合航空攜手杜勒斯機場推動逾200億美元翻新計畫
zh.summary: 聯合航空7月29日宣布與華盛頓都會區機場管理局及美國運輸部合作，啟動超過200億美元的華盛頓杜勒斯國際機場翻新計畫。內容包括新建及現代化大廳、汰換移動式登機廊、升級安檢與行李系統，並預計於2026年底啟用新增14個登機門的E大廳。
body: 聯合航空（United Airlines）於2026年7月29日宣布，將與華盛頓都會區機場管理局（MWAA）及美國運輸部（DOT）合作，推動一項總額逾200億美元的資本投資計畫，目標在未來十年內全面改造華盛頓杜勒斯國際機場（IAD）。
根據聯合航空說明，該計畫包含超過500萬平方英尺的新建或翻修空間，涵蓋現代化航廈大廳、升級報到櫃台區域及主航廈翻新，同時將保留建築師埃羅·沙里寧的原始航廈設計。
美國運輸部部長Sean Duffy表示，規劃內容包括汰換機場老舊的移動式月台車系統和過時的航廈大廳，取而代之的是最先進的設施。機場管理局總裁暨執行長Jack Potter則指出，新建設是基於與航空公司夥伴共同研擬的多年期主計畫，並歸功於聯邦政府加速了計畫進度與規模。
聯合航空執行長Scott Kirby稱此項計畫為該航空公司對其杜勒斯樞紐長期投資的延伸，旨在提供世界級機場體驗，並感謝政府部門對該計畫的支持。
此次轉型幾乎觸及機場體驗的各個面向，包括升級停車與報到區、更有效率的安檢、以及新建或現代化航廈大廳，其中包含完全重建現有的C/D大廳，以容納更大型飛機並飛往更多目的地。
該項計畫也將導入新的AeroTrain捷運系統和一條中央步行隧道，最終取代機場現有的移動式休息室車輛，並包含連通至全新、更大規模的海關設施的步行通道。
部分現代化工程已在進行中，新的E大廳預計將於2026年底啟用，屆時將新增14座聯合航空登機門，為該航空公司提供更多國際航線量能，以及直接通往機場AeroTrain系統和新旅客休息室的通道。

en.title: United, Dulles Airport unveil over $20 billion overhaul including new concourses
en.summary: United Airlines announced a partnership with the Metropolitan Washington Airports Authority and the US Department of Transportation on July 29, 2026, for a more than $20 billion capital investment program to transform Washington Dulles International Airport. The plan includes modernized concourses, upgraded screening, replacement of the mobile lounge system, and a new Concourse E with 14 United gates expected to open in late 2026.
body: United Airlines announced on July 29, 2026, that it is partnering with the Metropolitan Washington Airports Authority and the US Department of Transportation on a more than $20 billion capital investment program aimed at transforming Washington Dulles International Airport (IAD) over the next decade.

According to the announcement, the plan calls for more than five million square feet of new or renovated space, including modernized concourses, upgraded ticketing areas, and a renovated Main Terminal, while preserving architect Eero Saarinen’s original terminal design.

US Transportation Secretary Sean Duffy specifically pointed to plans to replace the airport’s aging mobile lounge system and outdated concourses with a state-of-the-art facility. Airports Authority President and CEO Jack Potter said the new construction builds on a multiyear Master Plan developed with airline partners and credited the Trump administration for accelerating the pace and scope of the plans.

United CEO Scott Kirby framed the project as an extension of the airline’s long-term investment in its Dulles hub, calling it the gateway that connects the nation’s capital to the world and saying the transformation is meant to deliver a world-class airport experience.

The transformation will touch nearly every part of the airport experience, with plans including upgraded parking and check-in areas, more efficient security screening, and new or modernized concourses, including a full replacement of the current C/D Concourse designed to accommodate more and larger aircraft flying to more destinations.

A new AeroTrain system and a central walking tunnel are intended to improve movement between the terminal, concourses, and gates, eventually replacing the airport’s mobile lounge vehicles altogether. The project also includes a walkable connection to a new, larger US Customs facility.

Some modernization efforts at Dulles are already in motion. A new Concourse E, featuring 14 additional United gates, is expected to open in late 2026, giving the airline more capacity for international routes along with direct access to the airport’s AeroTrain system and new passenger lounges.
